items.title: impeccable slips but holds the design crown with 2,299 stars today
items.summary:
a design vocabulary for coding agents: polish, critique, bolder and audit as commands, shipped as a rust cli.
2,299 stars today and 96,644 total, still top of the page after yesterday's 2,870.

items.title: deeptutor closes to within 17 stars of the top with 2,282 today
items.summary:
an open-source tutor that keeps a model of each learner and carries it across sessions, python under apache-2.0.
2,282 stars today and 51,497 total, up from 1,930 this morning and now second only to impeccable.

items.title: the jailbreak list keeps climbing: 2,053 stars and still no licence
items.summary:
a bare list of prompts with no code and no licence, updated twice since it appeared.
2,053 stars today and 10,317 total, and still the strangest entry in the top five.

items.title: superpowers adds 1,255 stars for a whole development method
items.summary:
a skills framework that packages a full software process, from planning to review, for agents to load on demand.
1,255 stars today and 309,222 total, the largest repo on the page by total stars.

items.title: a chinese astrology engine appears with 1,146 stars today
items.summary:
zi wei dou shu charting in typescript: the full placement algorithm, the four transformations, a pattern library and the classical source texts.
1,146 stars today and 10,999 total for a repo with no english description at all.

items.title: claude-mem gives agents a memory and picks up 1,145 stars
items.summary:
it records what an agent does in a session, compresses it, and injects the relevant parts into the next one.
1,145 stars today and 105,685 total, apache-2.0, and it works across harnesses rather than one vendor.

items.title: t3code puts six agent harnesses behind one remote control
items.summary:
a control surface for claude code, codex, cursor, grok build, opencode and antigravity from a phone, the web or a desktop app.
920 stars today and 32,463 total, with a readme that insists there is nothing for sale here.

items.title: openmausbot holds at 899 stars with commits landing this hour
items.summary:
an open-source grok bot alternative: several agents with their own workspaces, task queues and a shared virtual machine.
899 stars today and 8,179 total, down from 1,199 this morning but still shipping within the last hour.

items.title: iran now counts five vessels hit around hormuz, and oman rescues 25 crew
items.summary:
the irgc navy said it stopped two tankers on the southern route and that a supertanker caught fire after a mine, while iran's regular navy reported two more burning in the east.
oman's navy pulled 25 crew from a vessel 196km off musandam, and iran says it also destroyed an unmanned enemy submersible.
items.change: from three tankers this morning to at least five, plus a confirmed rescue and a claim that an unmanned submersible was destroyed.

items.title: a senator calls the post-election iran plan 'insane' after a classified briefing
items.summary:
chris murphy says he and other senators were briefed on a plan that could hit civilian infrastructure and cause a devastating escalation once the midterms are over.
trump, on kansas city radio, said the war is 'going to get wrapped up soon' and that any deal needs a guarantee that iran never gets a nuclear weapon.
items.change: murphy went public with what he was briefed on, and trump put a rough end date on the war for the first time since the vance letter.

items.title: riyadh takes another missile night and a drone over mecca
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a houthi drone over the mecca region on friday morning, plus a cruise missile over western saudi, a day after downing two ballistic missiles over riyadh.
debris from the riyadh interceptions hurt one person and damaged a house and a car, while the houthis deny targeting mecca and say they only hit oil and military sites.
items.change: a drone over mecca and a cruise missile over the west on friday, after two ballistic missiles over the capital on thursday.

items.title: qatar sends mediators to tehran to keep the ceasefire alive
items.summary:
a delegation headed by the prime minister's senior adviser arrived on friday morning, coordinating with washington, iran's state news agency reported.
it follows jd vance's letter to mohsen rezaei, which tehran reportedly read as far more respectful than earlier us messages, though no formal reply has come.
items.change: the first qatari mission to tehran since the vance letter, while the strike plan stays on the table.

items.title: israel's deadlock holds as both camps start coalition talks
items.summary:
likud's 27 seats leave netanyahu's bloc on 53 and the opposition on 48, with the arab-led parties' 19 seats deciding who can govern.
netanyahu met ben-gvir and smotrich while eisenkot's camp talked to the arab parties, and eisenkot accused likud of trying to delegitimise the vote as shin bet probes foreign funding.
items.change: the talks moved from arithmetic to actual meetings, and the shin bet probe became the opposition's central complaint.

items.title: houthis open a ground front north of lahj as taiz keeps taking shells
items.summary:
dozens of government fighters and houthis were killed or wounded in al-maqatirah, the mountain gateway to lahj, according to uae-based al-ain news.
the taiz governor says the city is under a suffocating siege with no medical supplies, water or fuel getting in, and clashes have escalated around jabal saber.
items.change: a large ground attack in lahj, not just the shelling around taiz.

items.title: the fired planner confessed on camera after failing four polygraphs
items.summary:
lt gen brett sylvia admitted leaking classified material on iran and ukraine to reporters, axios reported, after failing four polygraph tests.
hegseth fired the pentagon's top military planner earlier this week after the four failed polygraph tests.
items.change: from an accusation of leaking to a reported on-camera confession after four failed polygraphs.

items.title: the gulf's trillion-dollar defence looks different after 4,670 drones
items.summary:
an iiss study says 12 regional states faced 4,670 one-way attack drones and more than 1,400 ballistic missiles before the april ceasefire, nearly half of them aimed at the uae.
damage to energy infrastructure is estimated as high as $58bn, and the report questions whether us bases still buy the protection the gulf paid for.
items.change: first hard accounting of what the iran war cost gulf defences.

items.title: the nasdaq sheds 2.63% and the vix jumps 17.15% as the ai trade cracks
items.summary:
mid-session the s&p is down 1.63% at 7,594.75, the nasdaq composite down 2.63% at 25,496 and the dow down 0.74%.
futures are weaker than cash, es -1.54% and nq -3.06%, and the vix is at 20.15.

items.title: intel's 29% fall is its worst day since 1974
items.summary:
guidance blamed a plant shutdown in israel and a soft pc market, and d.a. davidson cut the stock to neutral under the title 'not fixed yet'.
the shares are still up about 150% this year even after friday's fall.

items.title: reddit has its worst day ever, down 28%, and roblox drops 19%
items.summary:
reddit pointed to weak sales guidance and a plan to test a login wall as google search traffic shrinks.
roblox fell 19.4%, coinbase 13%, illumina 18% and twilio 17% in the same unwind.

items.title: nvidia -4%, broadcom -6%, qualcomm -12%: the chips lead the way down
items.summary:
alphabet fell again after thursday's record 12.6% drop, and amazon slipped 1% after a second straight quarter of negative free cash flow.
the week's earnings are being read as an ai cost problem now, not an ai growth story, and the nasdaq is heading for a sharply lower week.

items.title: exxon and chevron hit all-time highs as war refining profits double
items.summary:
exxon earned $15.4bn, double last year, and chevron $9.9bn, up nearly 200%, both beating estimates on diesel margins.
us diesel averaged $6.32 a gallon, more than 70% above a year ago, as attacks on refineries cut global capacity by millions of barrels a day.

items.title: brent tops $113 as the hormuz incidents outweigh the vance letter
items.summary:
brent is up 2.55% at $113.62 and wti 2.01% at $104.05, putting crude on course for a sharp monthly gain.
reuters reports the 2026 brent view has topped $90 for the first time since may as mid-east stability stays out of reach.

items.title: wage costs cool to 0.8% while chicago pmi misses
items.summary:
the employment cost index rose 0.8% in the third quarter, in line, with wages up 0.7% and benefits 0.9%.
chicago pmi came in at 55.3 against 56.1 expected and 58.8 last month, the last major growth print of the week.

items.title: binance says a laptop hack cost $6.3bn, the biggest crypto theft on record
items.summary:
a compromised devops laptop let an attacker submit unauthorised withdrawals, and about $3bn has been frozen since.
bitcoin is at $77,478, down 0.6%, and arab news reports the heist is being blamed on north korea.

items.title: arsenal bring rice, calafiori and tzolis to anfield but lose saka to december
items.summary:
arteta says the three trained on friday and will be available if they come through saturday, while saliba is out until late november and saka's thigh keeps him out to december.
dowman is suspended for the trip after his red card at fleetwood, and madley referees sunday's 19:30 riyadh kick-off.

items.title: szoboszlai and munoz both have a chance of making sunday
items.summary:
iraola said the pair, out for the last three games with a hamstring problem and a knee knock, could be involved but he is not certain.
frimpong is out until after the november break, with leoni, bradley and ekitike still sidelined.

items.title: bournemouth at home in the quarter-finals after arsenal's fleetwood shock
items.summary:
liverpool host bournemouth in the week starting december 14, while fleetwood town, who beat arsenal on penalties, host everton.
arsenal's midweek also ended with a red card for 16-year-old max dowman that carries a three-match ban, upheld on appeal.

items.title: alisson is left out of brazil's november squad
items.summary:
liverpool confirmed the goalkeeper is not in brazil's squad for the november friendlies, so he stays at kirkby through the break.
ancelotti is using the window to rebuild the squad, so alisson stays at kirkby instead of travelling.

items.title: valencia look ready to cut harvey elliott's loan short
items.summary:
the la liga side are in the relegation zone, elliott has six substitute appearances and a red card, and a valencia expert told the daily mail they would likely terminate the deal.
because he only played friendlies for liverpool this season, he could go out on a fourth loan rather than return to the squad.

items.title: araujo's £47m option looks a formality and johnson says wait on a right-back
items.summary:
the uruguayan has played all 13 games on loan from barcelona, mostly at right-back with frimpong and bradley out, and his agent has spoken about his future.
glen johnson says liverpool should see how bradley returns before buying a specialist right-back.

items.title: mac allister's people are already shopping him around
items.summary:
sky sports switzerland, via the echo, says liverpool will not extend mac allister and his representatives have begun offering him to la liga, serie a and saudi clubs.
his deal runs to 2028, so any move would be a sale this summer as part of the rebuild rather than a free transfer.

items.title: kuyt takes interim charge of fenerbahce before facing liverpool
items.summary:
liverpool confirmed the former forward has been put in interim charge of fenerbahce, who meet the reds in the champions league next week.
kuyt was assistant to ismail kartal and made 285 appearances for liverpool between 2006 and 2012.
